key_impacts: PHIVOLCS issued Tsunami Alert Level 3 at 21:01 for immediate evacuation of multiple coastal provinces.
Evacuations conducted in most surveyed barangays; estimated average 80% of residents evacuated.
No significant tsunami occurred and no damages were reported; alert cancelled early 2012-09-01.
Shaking up to intensity V–VII reported in Pacific coastal areas of central-southern Philippines.
Communication disruptions caused delayed or distorted warnings; power cuts, mobile outages, and one incorrect radio broadcast reported.
evidence_snippets: On 31 August 2012 a strong earthquake occurred in the Philippine Trench east of Eastern Samar.
At 09:01 pm PHIVOLCS issued alert level 3 for coastal areas of Northern Samar, Eastern Samar, Leyte, Southern Leyte, Surigao del Norte and Surigao del Sur.
No significant wave appeared; no damages; PHIVOLCS cancelled the tsunami alert at 12:10 am on 1 September 2012.
missing_information: Exact list of evacuated barangays not specified.
No quantified damage or casualty figures.
Tsunami wave heights along the Philippine coast not detailed.
